Amount reconciliation gate failed: printed/extracted gross INR 853,811.10 vs itemized sum INR 914,760.85. Case-level flagged_for_review gate was true (Printed net 189771.25 was inconsistent with the itemized total 914760.85 and was recomputed.). Strict confidence gate failed: 0.600 is not greater than 0.900.

The integrity guard rejected printed net INR 189,771.25 as unexplained by the itemized amount INR 914,760.85, recomputed the net, set amounts_match=false, and capped confidence. Confidence was capped after the amount-integrity failure, so low confidence is a consequence of the same reconciliation defect. All 16 bill pages were categorized as supporting/interim; the merged main bill combined summary headers and detailed pages, while deposits/receipts were also admitted into consolidation.

No page was classified as a final bill, so supporting/interim documents were combined across incompatible scopes. Reference workbook/PDF evidence: The ground-truth final bill shows total INR 189,771.25 and net payable approximately INR 189,771, with a pharmacy return of INR 1,048; A separate INR 50,000 payment receipt is evidence of payment, not an additional medical charge. Downstream adjudication overall_status=fail; it is corroborating context and does not set bill_summary.case_verdict. The ground-truth final bill total is INR 189,771.25 with pharmacy returns, but the output carried INR 853,811.10 extracted and INR 914,760.85 itemized across 168 lines.

Separate final bills from deposits, receipts and supporting bills; reconcile each document independently before claim-level aggregation. Recognize the final-bill summary/detail sequence as one authoritative document, treat deposits/payment receipts as evidence rather than charges, and keep returns signed.
